Implemented `FieldNamingPolicy.UPPER_CASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES` in `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/FieldNamingPolicy.java`.

It converts camel-cased Java field names into uppercase, underscore-separated JSON names using `Locale.ENGLISH`, for example `productName` becomes `PRODUCT_NAME`.
